observations.body: The scene includes the Son of Man, nations, and separation. It also includes acts toward the least, the kingdom, and prepared fire. It also includes the devil and his angels, punishment, and life. Together, these details form a judgment scene.

payload.tension: The passage states the scene includes the Son of Man, nations, and separation. It also includes acts toward the least, the kingdom, and prepared fire. It also includes the devil and his angels, punishment, and life. Together, these details form a judgment scene. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Satan's story.
